cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've drawn a south arrow like yours. Migration confirmed. Help me steer the house before it takes the driveway.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine marks the slope. The surveyor says subsidence; he's bringing concrete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Slope noted. Concrete would trap it in the road. Tell him we're planning a route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His truck's blocking the road already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Ask him to lead slowly toward the empty plot. The house needs a guide.

reason: Copied slope marking becomes migration certainty; actual truck obstruction supplies actionable version of A impossible explanation.
